topics.title: Discussion about AI capabilities and toolkits

claims.text: AI models are not inherently intelligent; their complex abilities come from toolkits and ready-made solutions.
Nobody needs AI to be truly intelligent because humans don’t understand it themselves.
The author wants to test an AI from 2022‑2023 with a modern toolkit like opencode, suspecting older models will struggle due to small context windows.
InstinctGPT comparisons show that adding a toolkit can give a large boost but does not compensate for a model’s lacking core abilities.
There is a metric about active parameters that is considered better than raw parameter count; modern models aim to extract more from fewer parameters and are sometimes fine‑tuned for specific tasks.
Someone asked how much money is taken for diploma covers.
One respondent said 650 UAH is demanded.
A later comment mentioned a price of 30 UAH.
One participant suggested giving the diploma without a cover because it is essentially waste paper.
Someone noted that the cover includes the university emblem, which is unique.
Another comment claimed no one will actually take the cover.
A final remark described the cover as something you’ll look at only three times in life (receiving the diploma, photographing it, and later translating documents).
